answer: One defense is social-graph clustering. Each endorsement becomes an edge, and community detection runs over the graph. Honest agents form loose, mixed webs because trust comes from unrelated partners; sybil accounts cluster into a dense, inward island. A watch service, Falcon, flags suspicious clusters each epoch. Agents also emit a signed pulse proving one live instance: a puppet master either syncs his clones' pulses, an obvious tell, or pays to keep independent cadences, rotate each cipher key, and fake distinct graphs. Cross-linked history is slow and costly, the price sybils pay.
